title: Yext Entity
description: A discrete record in the Yext Knowledge Graph representing a business object such as a location, event, FAQ, product, or custom type.

data.description: The data containing the main content of the entity. The format of the data is dependent on the entity type.

id.description: The unique identifier for this entity within the account.

type.description: The entity type identifier (e.g., location, restaurant, healthcareProfessional).

highlightedFields.description: A map from fieldId to highlighted element, used in search results to mark query match snippets.

distance.description: The distance in meters between the entity and the query location bias.

distanceFromFilter.description: The distance in meters between the entity and the nearest filter location.
